name: @red-cup-engineering/cloudflare-tunnel-ingress-verification-service
description: Verify that a named tunnel's route binding and systemd unit conform to the fixed laptop-owned token-file ingress shape.

x-agentic-metro-enterprise.admission: no writes; reads one route-binding JSON and one systemd unit and reports ACCEPT or REJECT against caller-declared --expect-* values
x-agentic-metro-enterprise.refusal: VPS application execution, Cloudflare Access substitution for Google Leader identity, any hostname/service/fallback not matching the caller's declared expectation, and any credential-file interface
